claims.quote: The native range of the Sally Lightfoot Crab is extensive. It is found on the Pacific coasts of Mexico, Central and South America, the Atlantic coast of South America, the Western Atlantic from Florida to Brazil, and the Eastern Atlantic from Madeira, the Azores and the Cape Verde Islands to the coast of Africa, from Morocco to Ghana, and offshore islands of the Gulf of Guinea.
